mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_keyword_log (tenant_id, user_id, keyword, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{keyword}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM search_keyword_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND keyword = #{keyword} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) LIMIT 1

SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM search_keyword_log WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY keyword HAVING CHAR_LENGTH(keyword) >= 2 ORDER BY cnt DESC, keyword LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM search_keyword_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
